text: In cingulate cortex neurons, early endosome number, size and area fraction were higher in APOE4/4 than APOE3/3 mice at 18 and 25 months. This is class 5 because endosome morphology is not pH.
description: APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3 targeted-replacement mice, 8 mice per genotype at each age; 18 months (267 vs 286 neurons) and 25 months (342 vs 141 neurons); Rab5a immunofluorescence, ImageJ particle analysis, Student's t-test, values normalized to the APOE3/3 mean. Caveat: aged mouse neurons, not human astrocytes; pH not measured.

provenance.excerpt: an increase in mean early endosome number (an increase of 30.5 ± 4.0%; Figure 5B), size (33.5 ± 8.0%; Figure 5C), and area fraction (70.1 ± 4.8%; Figure 5D) was seen in the 18 month-old APOE4/4 mice as compared to APOE3/3 controls, a difference that persisted in the 25 monthold animals (endosome number: 73.3 ± 8.4%; size: 20.7 ± 2.7%; area fraction: 71.8 ± 10.4%).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4, aged) -> (enlarged and more numerous neuronal early endosomes) [morphology, not pH]

warnings: directness class 5: description should say why no class fits
